description: This file defines the NetNode class, which extends PcbNode, representing a network node in a PCB-related context. It includes fields for node identification and name, and logic to assign a static GND_NET_ID if the node is a ground.

classes.name: NetNode
classes.description: Represents a network node in a PCB context, with identification, naming, and ground network assignment.

methods.name: NetNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NetNode with a name, id, and children list, and identifies if it is a ground network to assign GND_NET_ID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the NetNode including its id.
